MOVE-A03.scope: Scene-long target blocking; Jaw Lock blocks both participants until either leaves or faints; normal/forced Switcher effects are prevented. Target exit ends its block; ordinary source departure does not end a whole-scene effect. Run Away remains immune.

Anchor Shot.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.

Jaw Lock.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Blocks both User and Target. Whole Scene Duration.

Spirit Shackle.effect: Single Target. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.

Thousand Waves.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Ranged. Unique. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.

ruling.review: Extracted definitions: Blocking prevents escape/recall/switching and Switcher effects; ongoing damage is 2 typeless dice, first source only.

snap_trap.decision: Printed prose and icons show scene Blocking only. Remove unsupported OngoingDamage metadata in the application correction layer.
